How a project works

Tell us what you want to learn, which rules you want to automate or what is missing from your current setup.

  1. Define the scope

    We agree on what the guide should cover or what the software needs to do.

  2. Build and test

    For software projects, we agree on the scenarios to test, such as rejected orders or exchange connection failures.

  3. Review the delivery

    We review the material or walk through how to read the software and its test results.
